text:
Alex: Heads-up — got a third 429 surge in prod this week, looks like a burst from a single customer. CS already flagged it.
Maya: Copy. Which dashboard/alert picked it up? Our 429 alert has been pretty noisy lately.
devops-bot: Alert: 429_spike_high triggered for prod-cluster-1 at 2026-03-15T10:11Z (severity: warning)
Alex: Alert fired on the global 429 rate. We need a per-org breakdown and a burst-window metric to cut the noise.
Luis: +1. Proposal: two new panels — (1) 429 rate per org (1m and 5m rolling windows), (2) burst ratio = peak_rps / sustained_rps per org.
Anne: Also create a derived metric "quota_exhaustion_rate" = 429s / (200s + 429s) per org (200s represents successes). That will let us gate on true exhaustion vs transient hiccups.
Maya: Can you drop a PromQL snippet for quota_exhaustion_rate? I’ll wire it into the Grafana panel.
Luis: ```
# per-org quota_exhaustion_rate over 5m
sum by (org_id) (increase(api_responses{code="429"}[5m]))
/ (sum by (org_id) (increase(api_responses{code=~"2.."}[5m])) + sum by (org_id) (increase(api_responses{code="429"}[5m])))
```
Alex: Nice. For alerts, route org-level spikes to CS-oncall + eng-sre only if sustained > 2m and quota_exhaustion_rate > 0.1. Short spikes (<=2m) should go to infra channel to investigate infra flapping.
cs-oncall: If CS gets the page, quick checklist: 1) confirm org id, 2) check their rate plan & any recent quota changes, 3) ask for recent traffic patterns, 4) if urgent, apply temporary throttle to offending keys and open a ticket with the account team.
Anne: We should tag alerts with scope=key OR scope=org depending on whether a single API key is responsible (high per-key 429 concentration). That can help routing and playbook steps.
Maya: I'll add a masked-top-keys table (show top 10 keys by 429 count, mask last 6 chars) and a small snippet of recent prompts for context (privacy safe).
Alex: Also reduce flappiness: require both the 1m spike > X and the 5m exhaustion > Y before paging. Add a flapping-suppression window of 10m.
devops-bot: Saved dashboard draft: "Quota — 429 spikes (per-org)" (owner: @Maya). Link will be posted once finalized.
Luis: I'll follow up and add "quota_bucket" labels in telemetry so we can separate per-org reserved vs pay-as-you-go traffic. Then we can compute accurate cost impact per event. :thumbsup:
